entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Can't create non RID-specific tool package if compiling with RuntimeIdentifier set #51199
  • SSL Template Issue Causes Missing OSX Templates #51198
  • `dotnet nuget why` output indenting is off #51194

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]The hotkeys for "Ok" and "Cancel" don't display on "File in Use" dialog #50523
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]The hotkeys don't work on "File in Use" dialog #50522
  • SSL Template Issue Causes Missing OSX Templates #51197
  • Blazor [PersistentState(AllowUpdates = true)] issue with @rendermode InteractiveWebAssembly #51196
  • Publish a WebApplication project using `dotnet publish` will fail when it references a project with Exe outputtype #3307
    Discussion
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]After the installation is successfully canceled, the C drive still shows the dotnet directory #50521
  • VB template shouldn't wrap test class in a namespace #46886
  • Update MSTest templates to 4.0.0-preview.25454.2 #50651
  • [NETE2ESDK][Loc] .NET 10.0 RC 2 SDK Installer Shows VS2026 in English version but VS2022 in localized version #50899
  • dotnet help test is broken in 3.0.0-preview9 on Ubuntu 18.04 LTS #10478
  • [NETSDKE2E][Loc][Regression]With NET RC1 SDK installed, Workload information is unlocalized in output of dotnet --info #50507
